thread:
nina: new support ticket: user confused about `require` vs `import` for our JS SDK. they tried `const SDK = require('redwood-inference')` then `new SDK()` and got `TypeError: SDK is not a constructor`.

omar: that's the named vs default export problem. our examples only show `import { Client } from 'redwood-inference'` (ESM). we should show the CJS equivalent explicitly.

nina: they were on a legacy codebase using CommonJS. node 16. tried `require('redwood-inference')` and `require('redwood-inference/cjs')` — the latter worked. but support had to hand-hold.

docs-eng: propose small quickstart addition: a 2-row table mapping runtime -> entrypoint -> snippet. e.g.
- Node (ESM/bundler): `import { Client } from 'redwood-inference'`
- Node (CJS/require): `const { Client } = require('redwood-inference/cjs')`
- Edge (Vercel/Cloudflare): `import { Client } from 'redwood-inference/edge'`

andre: also add explicit note: "SDK exports named symbols (Client, utils). There is no default export. Do not `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference'`." saves a lot of confused attempts.

omar: include a tiny diagnostic command in docs: `node -e "console.log(require('redwood-inference/cjs'))"` showing `{ Client: [Function], version: 'x.y.z' }` so users can quickly verify.

docs-eng: good. we should also call out edge runtime gotchas: no `global`, no `process.env` at runtime, and bundlers may include node shims if pulling CJS. recommend the `/edge` ESM entry for edge.

nina: also found a TS annoyance: some TS + CJS users want typings. show this pattern: `/** @type {import('redwood-inference').ClientOptions} */ const opts = {}` when using require. and `import type { ClientOptions } from 'redwood-inference'` for ESM.

andre: request to engineering: add a CI smoke test that runs the CJS example (`node ci/cjs-smoke.js`) so we catch regressions where package.json exports change.

devx-bot: Created issue RW-DX-720: "Include CJS examples & edge guidance in JS SDK docs; add smoke tests" - https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/720

docs-eng: I'll open docs PR with the table + FAQ blurb. nina, can you add the sample-app test and ping me?

nina: yes, will add a tiny `cjs-smoke.js` that does `const { Client } = require('redwood-inference/cjs'); console.log(typeof Client)` and assert `function`. will PR today.

omar: and i'll double-check package.json `exports` to ensure we have conditional exports that resolve correctly for require in supported node versions. filing RW-runtime-234 for that.

devx-bot: PR template updated to remind authors to include both ESM and CJS snippets for JS SDK docs.

docs-eng: after PR lands, we'll update onboarding checklist: "Confirm user's runtime and recommend /cjs or /edge as needed."

nina: thanks all. small docs + test should reduce these hand-hold tickets. will post PR links when ready :rocket:
